meta.title: Mobile · touch layout
meta.description: Narrow-screen and touch layout, comfortable tap targets and on-screen-keyboard handling: the sidebar becomes a drawer, content takes the full width and wide tables scroll. Desktop layout is unchanged.

ui.settings.title: Mobile experience
ui.settings.description: Applies only on narrow or touch devices; desktop keeps the native layout. Settings are stored per profile.
ui.settings.refused: The Host rejected this change; the last accepted settings are shown.
ui.settings.error: Saving failed. Check the connection and retry.
ui.settings.unavailable: This profile serves no mobile settings, or they are read-only.
